miss.requiredPreflight: Stop unchanged runner if its coverage window includes first-observed-after-kickoff fixtures; preserve evidence and request a separately scoped orchestration fix.

preflight: Verify pregame/input/receipt hashes and valid pre-kickoff receipt
Match provider fixture and league identity
Require actually observed official FT regular-time score
If grade exists, read/verify and skip; do not overwrite

scorecard.cohort: MODEL_FORWARD only; group by sealed target kickoff UTC date, not grade date
scorecard.scheduled: Distinct observed provider fixtures; null if coverage incomplete; retain observed count separately
scorecard.eligible: Valid sealed fixtures plus unsealed NS fixtures with at least 60 seconds lead at audit time
scorecard.graded: Distinct valid postgame joins, including graded PASS
scorecard.pending: predicted + pass - graded; includes not-yet-started, unfinished and result-unavailable sealed fixtures
scorecard.unknownGrades: If grade storage cannot be verified, graded and pending are null, not zero
scorecard.writeMode: Future append-only timestamped scorecard revisions; no rewrite of source evidence

milestones.unit: Cumulative distinct valid graded PREDICTED fixtures across four leagues; PASS excluded; no historical rows; initial snapshot per fixture only
milestones.crossing: Record each newly crossed milestone once, in gradedAt then fixtureId order; snapshot review cohort at exactly N; batch crossings preserve each cohort
milestones.below100: Operational/formal descriptive review only; never engine-change evidence
milestones.at200: Internal research review; no automatic validation or model change
milestones.betweenMilestones: Operational checks only, no formal performance review
